caption: This drawing contains two renderings of the same object, a metal andiron with a decorative finial and cabriole legs ending in clawed feet. The main object, centered and about three-quarters of the total image height, is shown in realistic color, primarily shades of brass yellow, with some subtle gray and brown shading to suggest form and light. This object has a tall, intricately shaped vertical shaft topped with a spiral-twist ornament, bulging and curved segments down the shaft, and is supported by three outward curving legs terminating in detailed claw-like feet. A black shadow is cast to the left and behind the object. To the upper left, there is a secondary, smaller line drawing of the same andiron in black ink, with simple contour lines and no shading. Beneath this line drawing is a 12-inch scale labeled "INCHES." The artist's name, "JACK STALOFF," is inscribed in small block letters at the bottom right corner. The drawing is on a plain, lightly yellowed background, enclosed by a fine pencil border.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
